Backend: 10/10 new pytests pass (auth-gating for 6 admin endpoints against no-token & customer-token; schedule returns 10 slots with open/booked/blocked; block→public availability=false & POST /api/appointments returns 409; unblock reverses; admin cancels a booking → status=cancelled + slot freed; finance shape has all keys; add expense increases expenses_total by 42.50 and decreases net_profit by 42.50, list shows it, delete removes it and restores baseline). Full regression: 57/57 total pytest pass (47 previous + 10 new). Frontend UI: admin login → /admin redirect works; all 9 tabs present (Overview, Schedule, Appointments, Orders, Finance, Products, Customers, Reviews, Newsletter); Schedule tab for 2026-06-20 renders 10 slot cards; block-12:00 → unblock-12:00 → block-12:00 cycle works; Finance tab shows 4 stat cards (income/sales/expenses/net); Record Spending form (expense-desc + expense-amount + expense-submit) added a $12.34 expense that immediately appeared in Recent expenses and updated Expenses card + Monthly breakdown. Confirmed admin portal is NOT linked anywhere on the public site: 0 admin links on Home, 0 in Footer; only 1 'Admin login' link on customer /login page (as required). Test data cleaned up (TEST expense deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `get_current_admin` returns 403 for BOTH missing-token and role-mismatch cases (never 401). Not a bug per current spec (spec accepted 401 OR 403) but semantically 401 is more correct for missing auth. Minor.
AdminDashboard.jsx `useEffect` deps use `user` but not `logout` — React 18 lint would flag exhaustive-deps; harmless.

AdminDashboard `loadAll` fetches 9 endpoints in parallel every mount + after every action (block/unblock/cancel/expense) — heavy on large data. Consider partial refresh (only affected slice) for future scale.

Backend /api/admin/schedule includes `cancel_token` inside `appointment` payload of open-slot response — this is admin-only so it's fine, but if this payload ever leaks to a non-admin channel it would be a data-exposure risk. Consider dropping cancel_token from admin schedule response too since the admin doesn't need it (uses appointment.id to cancel).

server.py block/unblock lack input validation — no check that `time` is in BUSINESS_HOURS and no check that `date` is a valid YYYY-MM-DD. Admin could block '99:99' or 'abc'. Low-risk since admin-only, but should validate.

server.py /api/admin/finance loads up to 5000 payment_transactions and 5000 expenses into memory each call — will not scale beyond that; add month/year filter param + aggregation pipeline before scale.
